name: Homebrew
description: Installs the Homebrew package manager and optionally a brew package

brewPackage.description: Name of Brew package to install (e.g. 'hmans/beans/beans')

brewPackageVersion.description: Minimum required version of brew package to install (e.g. '1.2.0')

brewArgs.description: Argument string to pass to the brew install command (e.g. '--build-from-source')
